title: Casino skim money driven in Cadillacs to fund the training base
place_text: Las Vegas / New Orleans / Miami / Mexico City

tellings.quote: would drive them and I know the guy that sold them the the Cadillacs cuz he had the big dealership there.

plain: In the early 1960s, money skimmed off casino takings by the mob figures Carlos Marcello and Meyer Lansky was supposedly driven around in Cadillacs to pay for a secret training base, with the trail running through Las Vegas, New Orleans, Miami and Mexico City. The lawyer Dan Sheehan tells Michels this in a talk about John F. Kennedy and says he knows the man who sold them the Cadillacs, who "had the big dealership there." If true, it would tie organised crime money to secret operations of the Kennedy years.
